description: Values placed throughout a structured JSON document — nested objects, an array of notes, a quoted alias. Escaping shifts every later byte offset in the file while leaving the decoded offsets alone, so the two coordinate systems diverge.

slots.name: alias
slots.label: person_name
slots.note: A quoted nickname inside the name. The quotes are escaped in the JSON source, so this value's decoded and source offsets differ, and so do those of everything after it.
